material:
trigger: none
schedules:
  - cron: "30 2 * * 1-5"
    displayName: weekday refresh
    branches:
      include: [main]
    always: true
pool:
  vmImage: ubuntu-latest
steps:
  - script: ./refresh.sh
note: ci-schedule-persistence-model: lib.codec.schedule_entries/persistence_answer via decode(rep='schedule_entries', transform=<field>[@what][!filename], key=<accepted csv>)
generator_cmd: sh tests/data/script_fixtures/sched_persist_gen.sh <dir>  (writes azure.yml: hand-authored heredoc; no lib code); sched_persist_fx.py writes the json
